data.summary:
Experienced Banking & Financial Services professional with 11.5+ years of expertise in Global Payments, Customer Onboarding, Payment Investigations, Transaction Banking, Reconciliation, SWIFT Operations, ISO 20022, Payment Transformation, and Project Delivery across global financial institutions including StoneX Financial, Commercial Bank of Qatar, JP Morgan Chase, Apex Fund Services, and OSFIN.AI.
Demonstrated experience in leading end-to-end transformation initiatives, payment operations migrations, workflow optimization, automation, stakeholder management, business requirement gathering, implementation support, governance, and cross- functional collaboration.
Strong exposure to customer onboarding, payment modernization, workflow orchestration, cross-border payments, regulatory change, operational transformation, project governance, UAT coordination, production deployments, and business process improvements. Proven ability to manage global stakeholders, lead teams of over 40 FTEs, and deliver strategic banking initiatives across Operations, Technology, Product, Compliance, and Business teams.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Manager – Banking Operations
OSFIN.AI | February 2026 – Present
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end implementation projects across Banking Operations and
Reconciliation transformation initiatives.
Manage project lifecycle from planning through execution and closure while
ensuring milestone adherence.
Drive reconciliation automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency. • Partner with Product, Engineering, Business and Implementation teams for successful project delivery.
Develop detailed project plans, resource plans, and implementation schedules. • Coordinate project meetings with internal and external stakeholders. • Track project risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans. • Support banking transformation initiatives through process optimization and operational improvements.
Serve as the primary stakeholder interface throughout project execution.
Relevant Skills
Project Management • Banking Transformation • Workflow Automation • Stakeholder Management • Implementation • Governance • Automation

Commercial Bank of Qatar | September 2017 – July 2020

Managed end-to-end payment investigations. • Supported Transaction Banking operations. • Worked on SWIFT payment processing. • Participated in migration of Payment Investigation processes from India to Qatar. • Coordinated knowledge transition and cross-functional training. • Worked with Trade Finance and Supply Chain Finance stakeholders. • Managed payment workflow improvements. • Resolved payment exceptions and customer escalations.
